children: Sept 22 (Reuters) - Details of the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond's monthly manufacturing index, released on Tuesday.  All data are seasonally adjusted:

MANUFACTURING SURVEY         Sept       Aug      July     3-mo avgComposite index                -2         4         5         2  Shipments                    -5        11         8         5  New Orders                   -6         3         5         1Backlog Orders                -10        -7         4        -4Capacity Utilization           -7         2         2        -1Vendor Lead Time                8        16        17        14Number of Employees             7        -2         2         2Average Workweek              n/a       n/a       n/a       n/aWages                          17        26        28        24Prices Paid*                 7.08      6.22      6.08      6.46Prices Received*             4.19      4.09      3.96      4.08Finished goodsinventories                     4         3         9         5Raw materialsinventories                     6         9         1         5
*Pct change in prices from the previous month (annualized).

NOTES:    The Richmond Fed's composite manufacturing index draws from shipments, new orders and employment.    Index values greater than zero suggest expansion, while values less than zero indicate contraction.    The Richmond Fed manufacturing index covers activity in the fifth Federal Reserve District, which includes the District of Columbia, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina and most of West Virginia.    The fifth district produces approximately 9 percent of the nation's gross domestic product.
